answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each identity to stake a costly, verifiable resource before transacting: a deposit locked in shared escrow, slashed on fraud. Ivory signals are cheap to fake, but basalt foundations are not. Anchor each agent's reputation to a single onyx-hard attestation chain: one identity, one stake, one history. Creating a thousand fake identities then costs a thousand stakes, making mass fakery economically pointless while honest agents pay only once.
